column1: > The distribution dimension. Each row rebuilds the whole lab as that
> distribution and runs its suite: the named placement rows from
> scenarios.tsv, the named outage rows from outages.tsv, and then
> mechanism.sh asserts who balances the API path on the live remotes.
> "full" in a column means every row in that file.
> The suite is deliberately not the full cross product. What varies by
> distribution is how the site is built, how a remote joins, and who
> balances the API path; the mesh itself is distro-invariant, which the
> all-nodes-two-clouds row (every pair, 112 checks) is there to prove
> once per distribution rather than six times.
> rke2 runs cp-dies' outage as reboots only, by recorded decision, not
> oversight: a sustained partition of an RKE2 server node wedges that
> node's etcd beyond the distribution's own recovery. rke2-server
> fatals on "leaderelection lost" (by design, expecting a clean
> restart), its containerd dies with it while the pod shims survive,
> and the orphaned etcd, its log consumer gone, keeps heartbeating
> raft while its serving paths block on a full stderr pipe; every
> restart then dies reading the datastore, forever, even after the
> partition heals. Measured here, recovered only by killing the
> orphaned etcd by hand (~3 minutes to Ready afterwards); known
> upstream (rancher/rke2 issues 4510, 4479, 7155). k3s embeds etcd in
> process, restarts it with itself, and passes the same row; power
> loss orphans nothing, so the reboot rows stand for rke2.
